headlines.title: 30-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2004 as bond market rout continues
headlines.summary: Alright, listen up. The long bond is getting absolutely hammered, with the 30-year yield hitting levels we haven't seen since '04. This ain't just some bond geek's problem; higher yields mean higher borrowing costs for everyone — companies, consumers, the whole nine yards. It's a major headwind for equities, especially growth stocks, and signals the market's still worried about inflation and more Fed hikes.

headlines.title: Meta's Muse reignites AI disruption fears. Traders are targeting this brokerage stock as next casualty
headlines.summary: Meta's new AI agent, Muse, is causing a stir, and not just for Meta. The Street's now looking at how this thing could disrupt entire industries, with brokerage firms and travel agencies already feeling the heat. This ain't just about one stock; it's a wake-up call for any business model that relies on traditional customer interaction. Keep an eye on financial services and consumer discretionary names.

headlines.title: Trump, Xi expected to talk Taiwan, AI, trade and Iran as DC summit kicks off
headlines.summary: The big boys, Trump and Xi, are meeting up, and the agenda is packed: Taiwan, AI, trade, Iran. Any word out of this summit can move the tape, especially for tech and manufacturing sectors tied to global supply chains. While a trade truce extension offers some short-term relief, the underlying tensions, particularly around AI and chips, are still a major overhang for global markets.
